{{Top|leg}}
The '''blight beetle''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of insect that was native to [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. It produced an alkaloid secretion that was used to marinate [[mulch mold]], creating a food that the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] considered a delicacy.
